title: Rule-Guided and Trajectory-Aware Repair for LLM-Based HLS Generation
title_zh: 基于规则的轨迹感知修复方法用于基于大语言模型的高层次综合生成

paragraphs.en: 提出MementoHLS双记忆修复框架，显著提升LLM生成HLS代码的成功率。 Large language models (LLMs) offer a promising path for directly generating functionally correct and synthesizable HLS-C from natural-language specifications. However, existing approaches often struggle to turn multi-round tool feedback and reusable HLS knowledge into effective revisions, limiting end-to-end generation success. We propose MementoHLS, an agentic HLS generation framework built around executable and falsifiable dual-memory-guided repair. MementoHLS combines an Executable Repair Contract Library (ERCL), which converts cross-task HLS knowledge into evidence-gated repair actions, with a Reviewer-Grounded Falsification Ledger (RFL), which converts task-local repair history into trajectory evidence to suppress ineffective routes and preserve validated progress. To ensure reliable outcome attribution, a Same-Candidate Reviewer binds Parse, Compile, Testbench (TB), and Synthesis (Synth) outcomes to the corresponding candidate, while a Single-Commit Arbiter commits at most one candidate per round. Evaluated on 94 HLS-Eval and 170 Bench4HLS tasks, MementoHLS improves same-candidate TB$\wedge$Synth pass@1/pass@5 from 41.7%/57.4% to 58.9%/68.1% on HLS-Eval, and from 15.5%/32.9% to 32.4%/50.6% on Bench4HLS, demonstrating substantial improvements in end-to-end HLS generation reliability.
paragraphs.zh: 提出MementoHLS双记忆修复框架，显著提升LLM生成HLS代码的成功率。大型语言模型（LLM）为从自然语言规格说明直接生成功能正确且可综合的HLS-C代码提供了一条有前景的路径。 然而，现有方法往往难以将多轮工具反馈和可复用的HLS知识转化为有效的修订，限制了端到端生成的成功率。 我们提出MementoHLS，一个围绕可执行且可证伪的双记忆引导修复构建的智能体式HLS生成框架。 MementoHLS将可执行修复契约库（ERCL）与评审者锚定的证伪账本（RFL）相结合，前者将跨任务HLS知识转化为基于证据门控的修复动作，后者将任务局部的修复历史转化为轨迹证据，以抑制无效路径并保留已验证的进展。 为确保可靠的结果归因，同一候选评审者将解析、编译、测试基准（TB）和综合（Synth）的结果绑定到对应的候选方案，而单一提交仲裁器每轮至多提交一个候选方案。 在94个HLS-Eval任务和170个Bench4HLS任务上的评估显示，MementoHLS将同一候选的TB$\wedge$Synth pass@1/pass@5在HLS-Eval上从41.7%/57.4%提升至58.9%/68.1%，在Bench4HLS上从15.5%/32.9%提升至32.4%/50.6%，证明了端到端HLS生成可靠性的显著提升。
